_note: PixelLab batches for the Tinker's Yard wrecks (o:56:<v>:<season>). Raw downloads: raw/<batch>/<slot>.png (node scripts/pl-fetch.mjs). Style references: raw/style/*.png, cut from the game's sheets and rusted by tools/styleref.mjs (press = st:cheese_press, keg = st:keg, battery = st:spring_battery, boulder = the nature sheet's o:5:0); w1_1 and w1_24 are W1 slots 1 and 24 graded onto the ramps. One candidate per wreck; art/ruins/build.mjs grades it and derives the four seasons.

W1.tool: create_1_direction_object, view top-down, style_images 24x24 (press, keg, battery, boulder)
W1.description: derelict rusted clockwork machine wreck in a ruined workshop, cozy farm game, warm rust red-brown with tarnished brass and copper, green moss patches and a creeping vine growing on it, dark plum outline, light from the upper left, top-down 3/4 view, sits on one ground tile, no glow, no text

W1.used: none in the game; slots 1 (boiler) and 24 (arm) were graded and sent as W2's style images
